loadBasis.label: How to record weight
loadBasis.review: Check the weight for this convention. Previous loads have not been reused automatically.

help.per_dumbbell: Enter ONE dumbbell's weight. Two 15 lb dumbbells: enter 15 lb. For unilateral work, record reps per arm.
help.total: Two dumbbells: add both weights. Two 15 lb dumbbells: enter 30 lb. Barbell: bar plus plates on both sides. Plate-loaded machine: total added plates; do not guess the machine's unloaded weight.
help.machine_display: Enter the stack or display reading. Do not multiply it by the number of handles or sides.
help.per_side: Enter the load on ONE side. Keep using this convention for this exercise.
help.unknown: Older records did not specify per dumbbell, per side or total. Their saved numbers are preserved.

loadBasis.changeHint: Changing the convention does not convert saved loads. Re-enter the working weight or check it during the next workout.
loadBasis.mixed: Weight conventions differ or are unconfirmed. Compare loads only within the same confirmed convention; recorded volume uses entered weight × reps.
loadBasis.recordedChoiceHint: This choice describes the numbers in this exercise for this workout. It does not convert weights or change other workouts or the routine.
loadBasis.activeChoiceHint: Confirms what these weights mean without converting them. This choice and your entered weights are saved for future workouts. Discarding this workout restores the previous defaults.
loadBasis.referenceOnly: Reference only. These weights are not current workout defaults.
loadBasis.useRecordedWeights: Use recorded weights with this convention
